summary: Kazan, Russia, software engineer with 20 years of experience in low-level and business programming, strong interest in web development and programming languages, critical of capitalism and modern web technologies, advocates for basic income and worker rights, prefers explicit coding practices, dislikes JavaScript and PHP, values simplicity and efficiency in software design, has a critical view of modern UX and advertising practices, identifies as a non-religious individual, has a preference for Linux and open-source technologies, engages in discussions about programming paradigms and software engineering ethics.
